shortDesc: Model Code of Conduct comes into force.
details: The Election Commission of India announces the election schedule. The Model Code of Conduct (MCC) comes into force immediately.

shortDesc: Final date to enrol or update your voter details.
details: This is the last date to file Form 6 (new registration), Form 7 (deletion), or Form 8 (correction) on the NVSP portal.

shortDesc: Candidates must file their nomination papers.
details: All candidates wishing to contest must file their nomination papers with the Returning Officer by 3:00 PM on this date.

shortDesc: Nomination papers are reviewed for validity.
details: The Returning Officer reviews all nomination papers. Invalid nominations may be rejected at this stage.

shortDesc: Candidates can still withdraw before this date.
details: Candidates who have been nominated can withdraw their candidature up to 3:00 PM on this date.

shortDesc: All campaigning must stop 48 hours before polls open.
details: The campaign silence period begins 48 hours before the scheduled polling time. No rallies, roadshows, or public meetings can be held.

shortDesc: Cast your vote! Booths open 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
details: Polling day! Booths open at 7:00 AM and close at 6:00 PM. Voters in the queue at 6:00 PM will be allowed to vote. Carry your photo ID.

shortDesc: EVM counting begins and results are declared.
details: The counting of votes begins at 8:00 AM. Results are typically announced throughout the day.
